title: Object Detection Systems
description: Anchors, IoU, Feature Pyramid Networks, YOLO evolution, and Transformer-based detection with the TF Object Detection API.
keyTakeaways: IoU = intersection / union of predicted and ground-truth boxes; threshold (e.g. 0.5) defines a true positive
Anchors are pre-defined box shapes tiled across the image; the model predicts offsets from anchors rather than raw coordinates
NMS removes duplicate detections by suppressing lower-score boxes whose IoU with a higher-score box exceeds a threshold
YOLO predicts class + box + confidence in a single forward pass — real-time detection by design
mAP (mean Average Precision) = area under the precision-recall curve averaged across all classes and IoU thresholds
